sign: West: Stillwater   North: the Wide Rift
sign_top: Halt Greyreach. No trains since the storm.
hut: A survey hut. Old charts of the uplands hang on the wall, every one of them grey.
brann: Brann: The scree up here slides if you look at it wrong.
kaja: Kaja: I measure the Greyreach every year. This year it measured me.
kaja_intro: Kaja: Hold still, I need a reference point. Ha, a duel will do.
kaja_defeat: Kaja: Noted. You are a fixed point.
edrik: Edrik: North of here the ground just stops. Like someone forgot to draw it.
edrik_intro: Edrik: Last stop before nothing. Duel?
edrik_defeat: Edrik: Go and look, then. Don't step too close.
